texts.arguments: 4.1 At the outset, learned advocate for the applicant submitted that Shri K. A. Patel, Public Analyst was not empowered to analyze the sample as at the relevant time, he was not appointed for the jurisdiction of Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation. He further contended that the said issue has been considered at length by this Court while delivering judgment in case of B. H. Patel, Food Inspector vs. Laxmandas Sevaram & Ors. reported in 2017(2) GLR 1709 and present case is also covered in view of said judgment. 5. In B. H. Patel, Food Inspector (supra), this Court observed and held as under: "Mr. Modi has drawn attention of this Court to the report at page 151 produced vide Exh.16 which is alleged to have been given by Public Analyst Mr.K.A.Patel on 20.12.1991 whereas the sample was sent on 26.11.1991. Mr.Modi also drawn attention of this Court to the notification issued by the Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Gujarat dated 24.9.1991 in exercise of the powers conferred by section 8 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 (the Act for short) amending the Parasmal Hanganilal Jain Jail vs State Of Gujarat on 25 April, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/180385653/ 2 notification of the Health and Family Welfare Department dated 12.5.1988. Ms.Jhaveri, learned advocate for the appellant has drawn attention of this Court that vide entry No.7 of the notification dated 1.8.1991, Mr.K.A.Patel, Junior Scientific Assistant was empowered and assigned the areas within the limits of Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation.
